title: Slide
codeHint: Anonymous patient code (salted hash); the raw patient ID is never stored.

score.title: AI risk score
score.aidOnly: Prioritisation aid only: the pathologist makes the diagnosis.

review.title: Pathologist review
review.startHint: Opening the slide moves it to Under review, so colleagues can see it is taken.
review.decideHint: Each decision archives the slide after you confirm it.
review.confirmBody: This records your decision and archives the slide. Archived slides can't be reopened.
review.retryHint: Run the analysis again, e.g. after a power cut or once the engine is fixed.

priority.hint: Manually prioritised slides are listed above AI-ranked ones, ordered by this level.
priority.hintReview: Sends the slide back to the worklist with this priority, above AI-ranked slides.
